brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has characterized the upcoming parliamentary elections as a "life or death" scenario for right-wing voters, Middle East Eye reported. Netanyahu used the language in an appeal to his political base ahead of the poll.

The characterization reflects Netanyahu's effort to mobilize right-wing supporters by presenting the election as consequential for their political interests and ideology.
dek: Netanyahu says election 'life or death' scenario for right-wing voters Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says the parliamentary elections are a "life or death" matter for right-wingers in Israel.
title: Netanyahu frames election as existential test for Israeli right-wing
